about: Launch live updates, newest first on the site. Add entries with: node tools/editorial.mjs live "text" --confidence confirmed --link article:slug. time = ISO datetime (or a date when the exact time isn't known). Only verified facts; label anything else.

entries.text: Rockstar announces that GTA VI pre-loading begins **November 10**.
Pre-loading opens. Rockstar's site switches to **"Pre-Load Now."** The install size is reported to be up to 212 GB.
Rockstar Store physical (code-in-box) orders start shipping. The box contains a download code, **not a disc**.
We re-checked Rockstar's official pages: the release is still **Thursday, November 19, 2026**, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Rockstar Store update: code-in-box copies now say pre-load **from November 12**, PlayStation codes work in **15 more countries**, and Rockstar says **Xbox codes aren't region-locked**. The store's video list now also names a **"Trailer 3"** and a **"Pre-Load Now Trailer"**.
Launch night: we went through every GTA VI settings tab on PS5. There's **no performance mode** in the Display tab, and Movement Speed was set to **Walk** on ours.
